verdict.rationale: The pack shows that Databricks has jobs (a Jobs REST API, serverless GPUs usable through jobs) and ETL pipelines for data orchestration. None of these items documents a recurring schedule, such as cron, time-based triggers or periodic runs. Running jobs or pipelines is not the same as scheduling them to recur, and the alerts item ('deliver notifications automatically') is an adjacent feature, so the evidence does not establish this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
